name: agent-panel
title: Agent Panel
description: An agent on a record: identity, acting for, state with its actions, instructions, latest, reply and runs with Undo; plus slot, chip, badge, ring and hover card.

meta.whenToUse: A record (a task, a table row) that is delegated to an agent: the rail card on its page, the section in its peek, the Delegate property's value, the pill in a peek or phone facts row, and the state mark or ring in lists and boards.
meta.whenNotToUse: A strip after an agent edited a document (AgentEditBanner), an agent asking before one action with a preview (ApprovalCard), or choosing the agent (DelegatePopover).
